narrative: 让摄影机移动。改变空间关系。
推进、拉远，或平行移动：关键在于承载装置本身在滚动，因此空间是靠相对运动来证明的。一张脸变大，是因为你走近了，而不是因为镜片焦距变长了。
当你需要房间的空间感是真实的时候，变焦（Zoom）就是错误的近亲。如果你只是需要从固定三脚架上得到一个更紧的画面，那就用变焦。
如果地面无法铺设轨道，就直说，改用稳定背心（vest）或摇臂，而不是假装用轮子拍摄。
how: 铺设水平的轨道，或直接让轮子在地面上滑行。高度由立柱设定（通常是眼平或胸高）。
推进和拉远沿着镜头轴线移动；横向平移（Trucking）本质上仍属于推轨。保持地平线的真实水平。
提示词：Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.
when: 当摄影机必须真正移动时使用：走近一张脸、离开一个房间、沿走廊滑行。不要把变焦称作推轨。
vs: 推轨推进（Dolly In）和推轨后拉（Dolly Out）指的是沿镜头轴线方向的运动。跟拍镜头（Tracking Shot）则是跟随一个移动中的主体。
变焦（Zoom）是在机身静止的情况下改变焦距，因此没有视差。推镜头（Push In）通常是用稳定背心或更随意的靠近方式；而推轨则是轮子和一条既定路径。
examples_film: 《闪灵》（The Shining）让摄影机在酒店的几何空间中滚动前行，直到空间本身感觉像一个陷阱。《好家伙》（Goodfellas）用轮式和背心式的移动，营造出连续的空间关系。
语法要点：机身在移动，房间在错动。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是变焦。破绽在于：近处和远处同时放大，台灯或门框之间没有产生错位。
修正方法：写明真实的物理移动和视差效果，并说明运动路径。

faq.q: 电影中的“推轨镜头”是什么？
faq.a: 推轨镜头是安装在轮式平台上的摄影机在空间中移动所产生的镜头，会带来视差效果。它是一条真实的物理路径，而不是变焦。

faq.q: 推轨镜头 与 变焦 的区别
faq.a: 变焦是在机身锁定的状态下改变焦距，因此空间会在没有视差的情况下被压平或打开。推轨则是移动摄影机本身，因此近处的物体会相对远处的物体产生错位。

faq.q: 什么时候该使用推轨镜头？
faq.a: 当空间关系必须通过移动摄影机来改变时使用。不要把固定三脚架上的变焦称作推轨。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写推轨镜头的提示词？
faq.a: 写出机身在移动，并带有真实的视差效果。示例：Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.

narrative: In, out, or beside: the point is that the support rolls, so space is proven by relative motion. A face can grow because you approached, not because the glass got longer.
A zoom is the wrong cousin when you need the room to be real. If you only need a tighter crop from sticks, zoom.
If the floor cannot take track, say so and use a vest or a crane instead of faking wheels.
how: Lay level track or dance the wheels on a floor. Height is set by the column (often eye or chest).
In and out ride the lens axis; a lateral truck is still a dolly. Keep the horizon honest.
Prompt: Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.
when: Use it when the camera must walk: approach a face, leave a room, slide a corridor. Do not call a zoom a dolly.
vs: Dolly In and Dolly Out name the axis along the lens. Tracking Shot follows a moving subject.
A Zoom changes focal length with the body still, so there is no parallax. A Push In is often a vest or a looser approach; a dolly is wheels and a path.
examples_film: The Shining rolls the camera through hotel geometry until space feels like a trap. Goodfellas uses wheeled and vest travel as continuous geography.
Grammar: the body moves, the room shears.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a zoom. The tell: near and far enlarge together, no shear of a lamp or a door frame.
The fix: write physical travel and true parallax, and name the path.

faq.a: A dolly shot is a camera on a wheeled platform that translates through space, producing parallax. It is a physical path, not a zoom.
A zoom changes focal length from a locked body, so space flattens or opens without parallax. A dolly moves the camera, so near objects shear against far ones.
Use it when geography must change by walking the camera. Do not use the word dolly for a zoom from sticks.

faq.q: How do I prompt Dolly for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a traveling camera body and true parallax. Example: Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.
